observations: Tall stack of black/dark grey plastic pallets photographed outdoors in a yard.
Approximately 13-14 pallets visible in the stack across the three photos.
Pallets appear to be the flat, perforated-deck, nine-leg style common for warehouse/logistics use.
Surface shows weathering, dust and some discoloration consistent with used/outdoor-stored stock.
Background shows other recycled plastic items (blue barrels, water tanks), suggesting a used/recycled plastics trading yard.
A watermark 'EMMY BEST INTEGRATED' overlays the images; no brand or manufacturer markings are legible on the pallets themselves.
No close-up of the underside, corners, or load-bearing feet is provided.

claims.claim: The image shows a tall stack of black plastic pallets.
claims.evidence: photo 0, photo 1, photo 2 all show a stacked column of dark plastic pallets.

claims.claim: Plastic pallets are a type of reusable...
claims.evidence: General statement about the product category, not a verifiable claim about this specific stock's condition or reuse history.

risks.risk: Exact count of pallets in the stack/lot is not stated, affecting total price.
risks.proof: A clear full-stack photo with a visible count, or seller's written quantity confirmation with a matching photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced per unit at the lowest plausible per-pallet rate for the visible stack size

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, chips, or broken legs on the lower/underside pallets, which bear the load and are not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each pallet's underside and corners, especially the bottom few in the stack.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with possible structural defects, i.e. lower than full-condition used price

risks.risk: Non-standard or mixed dimensions/weight ratings across the stack (pallets may not be uniform size).
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure or known reference object against a single pallet, plus a maker's mark if present.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/non-standard size, not premium standard-size pallets

risks.risk: Material degradation (UV brittleness) from prolonged outdoor storage, not visible from general shots.
risks.proof: Close-up of surface texture/color under good light, or a flex/press test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as weathered/used stock, not fresh/high-grade plastic

proof_requests: Confirm exact number of pallets included in this listing/price.
Close-up photos of undersides and corners of several pallets, especially bottom of stack.
A photo with a measuring tape against one pallet for dimensions.
Any visible manufacturer stamp or size/weight rating molded into the plastic.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a stack of used plastic pallets of a common type; lacking proof of exact count, condition of hidden surfaces, and standard sizing, it is priced at the worst-case assumption for a used, unverified-condition lot of the visually estimated quantity.
